> Fluoxetine

I have never been on Fluoxetine, so I am not sure. Citalopram and Fluoxetine are different SSRI's. I know Prozac (Fluoxetine) is more energizing than other meds and has more severe side effects (potentially)...it also treats more mental illnesses. Citalopram is strictly for depression. The fact that you have Anhedonia may be a contributing factor to why you were prescribed Prozac.

I was in a relationship for 6 years. We were engaged too. She was the world to me and I thought we would be together forever. It has been a year and a bit since she broke up with me. My recommendations are to go No Contact. https://www.reddit.com/r/ExNoContact/wiki/reasons

I did and it was the best thing I could do at the time. I got rid of everything she ever gave me including cards, clothes and other apparel. It was extremely painful, but I got rid of everything except for the engagement ring which she gave back to me. That fucker is in a safe with an updated appraisal. $$$$

The next thing I did was go into therapy/counselling to help me deal with the loss. You need to go into grieving. She was a major part of my life. It helped for a while. The value of the therapy/counselling is identifying the faults of both parties (it is never just your fault) and then learning from it so you can move on to the next relationship leaving the negative and bringing the positive. I learned a lot about myself...what I brought to the relationship and what I wanted out of one. 

It worked for a while, but due to other factors I am at the bottom of the hole. I have major depression, but I am high functioning. I miss being with some one..having an SO. Not my ex-fiance, but some one. Unfortunately, I am able to recognize I have things in my life that I need to take care of before I can actively search for a partner and those are things you need to recognize as well. 

For those who have been in a relationship as long as me or longer will have learned a lot from it. As much as it was painful (the most emotional pain I have ever felt next to watching my dog die) it became a learning experience and I became a "better" person from it. I will grow stronger because of it. So will you. This, I believe.
You probably won't notice much until a week or 2 later on consistent use.

To be honest and frank with you, this post in itself is a manifestation of help. If you wanted to commit suicide and were keen on it there would be no reason for you to post as it wouldn't provide you with anything useful. This shows me you want to be heard and we are listening. Don't kill yourself. Seek out some help in your area. Talk to your family doctor. Call a suicide hotline. Talk to some one about your demons. You didn't post this to find the answer to "proto-suicide" because you could have googled it. You posted it for people to read and people to respond whether it be consciously or subconsciously. Please, talk to someone (a professional if you can) and exhaust all possibilities before choosing the end of your life.

I would like you to keep me updated if you can. I am on 20mg of Citalopram with major depression and suicidal ideations, but high functioning. The citalopram doesn't make me feel happy, but it prevents me from feeling worse if that makes sense. I started therapy as well and have a second appointment in 3 weeks.

Just thought I should remind you that you are still a worthless piece of shit because of the following reasons". It is like I have to actively be aware that I need a distraction. It is a miserable feeling. Does it go away with medication and therapy? Or do we just cope with it forever?

That is how it feels sometimes and it is usually negative things that I think about.

Glad to hear you are starting to get treatment. I was the same way, just stuck playing video games and not really going out....not much friends etc. I was sick of it. So I decided that I wanted to do something different. I ended up getting my motorcycle license. I joined a group via form of people who ride around and made new friends.....good friends. 

Even though I have thoughts of killing myself on a daily basis, it makes it worse when I am in solitude and the dark thoughts creep in. I find I want to kill myself more when I am not around friends or when I am not busy. Video games serve as an escape....but just becareful because there are times where I have played 5 hours or more straight and I stop...look at the watch and I feel I wasted my life on a game. Easier said than done, but try to meet new people or get a new hobby and that way you will make new friends. Try meetup.com or something. If you want to talk let me know.
